# Universal Rules:

- Sound is not required for all categories, but is highly suggested to aid in the verification process.
- Emulators are banned (i.e. Bluestacks). 
- Downpatching is allowed. 
- Milliseconds will not be tracked.
- All categories are timed RTA. Refer to Category rules for specifics in timing.
